author: qwen3-coder-next
brief: Phase: NFR and performance. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 bulk-sync job (no dependencies; about 30 files) that fetches thousands of records from a service stub and writes them to a store, today firing every request at once with Promise.all. Inspiration (idea only): public concurrency-limit helpers. Build a task where the owner says the sync overloads the upstream and runs out of memory, and states numeric limits: at most N requests in flight at any moment (measured by the test server), peak queued items bounded, results kept in input order, one failure must not abandon the rest but must be reported, and total time on a fake clock must stay within a stated bound. Include wrinkles of your own design (a retry that must not exceed the in-flight limit, a slow item that must not block others, and cancellation on shutdown).
